candidate: H48 global ternary complete-neuron carrier plus private rank-five endpoint transport

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H46 retains a useful target-aligned global carrier but misses private moving directions. H47 preserves complete-neuron semantics but static layer gains neither align shared atoms nor execute efficiently at unaligned width 1421. Add one charged global low-bit carrier, layer-private basis-free endpoint transports, and tensor-core-aligned width 1408.

scientific_question: Can one frozen global ternary complete-neuron carrier plus layer-private rank-five endpoint transports reproduce all twelve terminal dense MLP functions and exact input JVPs under one percent checkpoint bytes, while cached materialization executes in at most 0.65 times dense MLP latency?

frozen_representation.formula: U_l=Q_U+A_U,l B_U,l; V_l=Q_V+A_V,l B_V,l; fhat_l(x)=sum_j g_lj V_l[j] GELU(U_l[j]^T x)
frozen_representation.global_scale_policy: one FP16 mean-absolute scale for every detector vector and every write vector; codes are round(value/scale) clipped to {-1,0,+1}
frozen_representation.global_bank_policy: deterministically acquire balanced paired teacher atoms, quantize once, freeze codes and scales, and never retain an FP32 master bank
frozen_representation.private_transport: independent FP16 A and B factors for detector and write endpoints in every layer
frozen_representation.layer_gain: one FP16 gain per layer and atom, folded into the materialized write endpoint before token-time execution
frozen_representation.atom_pairing: detector and write endpoints remain paired through acquisition, transport, storage and evaluation

teacher_derived_initialization.balanced_quota: select 118 complete neurons from layers 0--7 and 116 from layers 8--11, totaling 1408
teacher_derived_initialization.global_bank: copy each detector row and paired write row, then freeze the exact ternary codes and FP16 scales
teacher_derived_initialization.private_B: zero, so every layer starts exactly at the frozen global bank while retaining nonzero B gradients
teacher_derived_initialization.gain: one at an atom's source layer and zero elsewhere

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact input-JVP MSE
fit.optimizer: AdamW only on private rank-five factors and layer gains; global ternary bank is a frozen buffer
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.global_bank_only: zero every private endpoint correction and retain fitted gains
controls.private_transport_only: zero the global bank while retaining the identical fitted private factors and gains
controls.shuffled_layer_transport: cyclically assign every layer the next layer's private factors and gains
controls.random_global_bank: replace global codes by a deterministic equal-shape ternary bank while retaining the fitted private state
controls.dense_teacher: exact teacher output and input-JVP identity

systems_gate.candidate_kernel: materialize aligned FP16 U_l and gain-folded V_l once, then benchmark exactly two GEMMs plus GELU
systems_gate.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks for a run projected below two hours; resettable 90-minute heartbeat only after two hours

promotion: Only an all-layer representation pass plus systems pass can authorize one exact 124M 0.5TPP causal training test.
